item.title: Core Networking Concepts in AWS: Stateful vs Stateless
item.description: Amazon Web Services' Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) is the foundational networking layer for virtually every AWS workload. **Network Access Control Lists (NACLs)** and **Security Groups** implement firewall-like rules to restrict traffic in and out of that environment. Both sit at the perimeter of your infrastructure, both evaluate traffic rules, but they operate on fundamentally different principles — one is stateless, the other stateful. … Read more

item.title: DEFCON 34: Android Workshop - Part 1
item.description: I'm always interested in opportunities to improve my mobile app security testing capabilities, and I recently saw some Android mobile app labs shared online, which were developed by Sven Schleier for the Mobile Hacking Community at DEFCON 34. So, let's give it a go! At the end, we'll dig into some automation techniques and compare the results with our manual investigation. … Read more
